welcome.title: Your personal assistant.
welcome.subtitle: Right in your texts. Nothing new to open, nothing to learn.

values.title: It does the errands you keep putting off.
values.subtitle: Say it once. It finds the email, drafts the reply, chases the refund.

thread.text: Cancel my gym membership before it renews
Found the Equinox contract. It renews on the 1st, 30 days' notice.
Drafted the cancellation. Want to read it before it goes?

values.title: It reads so you don't have to.
values.subtitle: Read-only. It tells you what matters and who needs a reply.

thread.text: One email yesterday: lease renewal, rent up 4%. He wants an answer by Friday.
Want me to draft a counter?

values.title: It calls when that's faster.
values.subtitle: Two minutes on the phone beats twenty texts. You decide when.

thread.text: Too much to type, can you just call?
Call ended · 2:14. Dentist moved to Thursday, refund's on its way.

agent_name.title: And what do you want to call me?
agent_name.subtitle: That's how I'll show up in your contacts.

gmail.title: Connect Google so I can actually do things.
gmail.subtitle: Read-only. Nothing is ever sent without your yes.
rows: Read what came in, tell you what matters
Find the membership email, the lease, the invoice
Draft the reply for you to approve

call.title: Want me to call you to set up the rest?
call.subtitle: Two minutes, by voice. Or we keep going in Messages.

done.title: You're set.
done.subtitle: I'm in your Messages. Text me one thing you want off your plate.
done.calling: Hanging up here. Calling you now.

hero.title: Your assistant, right in Messages.
hero.subtitle: Text it like a person. It handles the inbox, the calendar, the subscriptions and the calls, and only asks when it matters.

features.title: Life admin
features.body: Handles the returns, forms and appointments you keep putting off.

features.title: The secretary
features.body: Reads what came in, drafts the replies, and only asks you when it matters.

features.title: Chief of staff
features.body: Sits on hold, argues the fee, and calls back until it's sorted.

features.title: The household
features.body: Books the dentist, orders the groceries, keeps the family on schedule.

features.title: Personal CFO
features.body: Finds the subscriptions you forgot and cancels them before they renew.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: Encrypted at rest, independently audited, never sold. Export or wipe everything in one tap.

wristband.name: Persona Band
wristband.body: A screenless aluminium band that hears you, understands what you said, and hands the task to your Persona in the time it takes to say it. No wake word, no app to open. One ring of light tells you where your task is: listening, working, done.
bullets: Two mics catch a whisper across the room; a speaker answers out loud
Ambient LED ring: listening, working, done
Three days of battery, full charge in 30 minutes
Pairs with the Persona app; approve with a tap or your voice

products.name: Persona
products.body: Your personal intelligence in Messages and on a call. It learns how you like things done and only asks when it matters.

products.name: Persona Band
products.body: The wearable: press to talk, a ring of light to confirm, three days of battery. Four colours.

products.name: Persona for iPhone
products.body: The full app: calls, Messages, Gmail, reminders and everything your Persona learns about you.

steps.title: Text or call
steps.body: Tell your Persona one thing you want off your plate, or take the two-minute call.

steps.title: One useful thing in the first minute
steps.body: An inbox triaged, a reply drafted, a subscription cancelled. Value first, questions later.

steps.title: Connect Gmail when it helps
steps.body: Read-only, only as the way to do your task. Nothing is ever sent without your yes.

steps.title: Your Persona gets a name
steps.body: Pick a name; it lands in your Contacts with its own card, and the Band hears it too.

footer.privacy: Your conversations are not a product. Not to advertisers, not to data brokers, not to anyone. Export everything in one tap, or wipe a task, a day, or all of it. Gone means gone, on our servers too.
